2. Case of the prosecution, in brief is that the complainant has lodged complaint alleging that co-accused Sunil Patel, Rajesh Mahilange and other two persons for providing employment on the basis of fabricated documents had taken huge amount of Rs. 18,50,000/- from him.
On 19.10.2022,
they took 1,00,000/- in cash and thereafter, he transferred Rs. 10,00,000/- in the account of Rajesh Mahilange and Sunil Patel and given Rs. 2,00,000/- in cash.

On 21.11.2022, Rajesh Mahilang took him to the office of the Divisional Railway Manger where he was given Service Book and an order copy for attending training.
